column1: # Country calling codes and trunk prefixes, for deriving an E.164 form of a number written without "+" (WPM-D152, WPM-T382).
# Columns: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, ITU-T E.164 country calling code, the national trunk prefix ("-" for a plan with none,
# where a leading 0 is part of the number). The trunk prefixes are those of the contact relationship management matcher
# 0.2.0's TRUNK_PREFIXES, keyed there by calling code, "from the ITU-T E.164 national numbering plans as summarised in public
# references, not checked against each regulator"; the country for each calling code was written by the AI assistant from
# its own knowledge on 2026-10-31 and was not read against the ITU list. Status: unverified. A country not listed here has no
# derived E.164 form for a number written without "+"; nothing is guessed. Codes shared by several countries (1, 7, 44, 61)
# list only the countries named here.
